prompts.01_防御塔升级设计稿.png:
Design presentation board for "代代守村", NOT a production sprite sheet. Use the two references as art-direction anchors: cozy Chinese countryside pixel art, warm brown rounded wood, warm irregular stone, visible top surfaces, three-quarter elevated view, clear chunky pixel shapes. NO frontal square medieval fortress blocks. Make a polished parchment-colored landscape concept board showing THREE tower families in THREE rows and FOUR representative upgrade stages in FOUR columns. Large readable beautifully rendered complete buildings, 12 complete tower illustrations. Lots of breathing room; a pale soft oval ground patch under each. All weapons point toward the viewer's RIGHT consistently. Each row has a small clean Chinese label at far left and columns labeled exactly "1级", "4级", "8级", "12级". Top title exactly "防御塔升级 · 造型设计稿". Tiny subtitle exactly "主体变化 · 部件复用 · 保留村落风格". Clear arrows between stage columns.
Row 1 label "箭塔": warm rustic wooden archer tower on low oval stone footings, first a small open raised timber platform with single small mounted crossbow, stage4 taller with thick X-braced legs and central ladder and surrounding railing, stage8 visible second wooden storey with broader raised platform and a large crossbow, stage12 strongly reinforced timber watchtower with stout stone feet, warm brass corner brackets, two mounted crossbows and tiered wooden platforms. It must remain clearly a WOODEN watchtower even at max, no stone skyscraper, no enclosed castle.
Row2 label "石塔": squat CYLINDRICAL warm-gray stone tower with wooden sling/catapult on top like reference. First simple low stone drum and light sling; stage4 larger rounded stone body and thick wood throwing frame; stage8 stronger stone footing and expanded ring parapet with larger sling; stage12 two stacked curved stone courses/platforms, reinforced throwing arm and few bronze joints. Compact, squat, heavy, no spires.
Row3 label "寒塔": warm timber-and-stone Chinese little pavilion with a pale cyan crystal. First little wood pedestal under tiny round straw canopy, single ice crystal; stage4 stout stone lower base and timber posts, teal conical tile canopy with clear cyan crystal; stage8 raised second tier, teal overlapping eaves and 3-crystal cluster; stage12 layered teal pagoda-like eaves, warm gold ridge trim, thick wood pillars, larger cyan cluster. Still miniature village defense structure, not glowing futuristic tower.
The first and last tower footprints are similar, final height only about 25% larger, upgrades change structure/material/number of levels rather than simply scaling. Consistent slightly top-down camera and sizes in every cell. No people, no HUD, no game screenshot; this is a tidy art approval sheet. Preserve the charming look of reference village buildings, big readable silhouettes, warm color, subtle pixel detail. No fabricated game stats or resource costs.
prompts.02_民居修缮与扩建设计稿.png:
Create a polished art approval concept board for a cozy Chinese pixel-art village game, matching the attached original building sprites and village concept closely. Warm parchment background, brown thin decorated borders, charming rural architecture, slightly elevated three-quarter view, broad sloped straw/tile roofs, warm timber and cream plaster, dark brown chunky pixel outlines. Landscape sheet, TWO clearly separated wide sections, four columns in each. No people or unrelated user interface.
Title exactly "民居 · 修缮与扩建设计稿".
Top section heading exactly "修缮：房屋数量不变，主体逐渐升级". Four complete single-home illustrations, labeled "1级", "4级", "8级", "12级". Same consistent building footprint and camera:
1: simple cottage with wide golden thatched roof, cream walls, timber corner posts, wooden door and square window, low stone footing.
4: larger terracotta tiled pitched roof, thicker timber framing, raised stone plinth, clearly visible new front porch supported by short posts.
8: two-story cream-and-wood cottage with a compact upper floor, blue-teal tiled broad roof, balcony over door, still humble village style.
12: refined two-story rural courtyard main house with tiered dark-teal tiled roof and a small projecting upper gable, modest warm-gold roof ridge trim, robust timber, clear porch. NOT a palace, no giant footprint. Main structure differences obvious even at thumbnail size. Keep whole-house heights reasonable, about25% difference max.
Bottom section heading exactly "扩建：新增房间看得见". Show four small building GROUPS on similar sized ground patches labeled "2间", "3间", "4间", "5间". Hold repair style constant (terracotta tiles, cream timber walls), focus on count expansion:
2间: TWO separate small one-room cottages.
3间: same TWO compact cottage groups, left cottage has a clearly added smaller side room with its own small lower roof and visible door; right cottage stays one room.
4间: both cottage groups have a side room with its own lower roof and door.
5间: left cottage group has main room+side wing+compact added upper-floor room with its own roof; right cottage group keeps main room+side wing. Make each additional volume distinct, do not show five separate freestanding houses.
Comfortable spacing, unified ground level, no overcrowding, show the added architectural volumes in a warmer terracotta highlight while retaining natural materials. Bottom small caption exactly "修缮看等级，扩建看房间；保留村民活动空间". No made-up prices or game statistics. Crisp readable Chinese headings, all objects fully inside frame. This is concept design for approval, not a screenshot or packed texture atlas.
prompts.03_村庄设施升级设计稿.png:
Art approval concept board for the same cozy Chinese village pixel-art tower defense game as the two reference images. Warm parchment background, subtle brown frame and small foliage corners, charming warm wood, thatch, terracotta and muted teal, elevated three-quarter camera, chunky crisp pixel outlines. Landscape board with THREE rows and FOUR columns, 12 complete building illustrations. Title exactly "村庄设施升级 · 造型设计稿". Columns exactly "1级", "4级", "8级", "12级". Row labels exactly "农田", "伐木场", "城门". No resource costs, game statistics, people or weapons.
Farm row: open UNFENCED walkable rectangular crop plot. Stage1 two small soil beds with young wheat. Stage4 three well organized beds, more golden wheat and a little stone irrigation channel. Stage8 orderly larger crop beds with clear empty footpath through middle and shallow water channels, small wooden irrigation wheel at back edge. Stage12 compact refined irrigated beds alternating golden wheat and green seedlings, two small raised channels, small wind/hand water wheel at back edge. No house, no surrounding fences, clear room for a farmer. These are appearance upgrades not different gameplay crops. Strong silhouette changes but footprint remains restrained.
Logging row: stage1 open-sided low straw-roof log shed with thick posts and stacked logs. Stage4 larger terracotta shed with a clearly added covered work bay and hand saw bench. Stage8 stout half-timber workshop with teal tile roof, attached low bay, side-facing wooden waterwheel and circular saw assembly. Stage12 two-tier compact timber workshop, raised middle roof section, deep covered work bay and organized larger log racks, warm brass details on structural joints. It must remain a forestry workshop, not palace.
Gate row: stage1 wooden double gates between round rustic timber posts with small straw roof. Stage4 taller double timber gate with substantial stone bases and terracotta canopy. Stage8 broad cream-and-stone gate arch with wooden doors and dark teal roof, visible wall thickness but NO wall extensions beyond base. Stage12 compact gatehouse with a small upper watch chamber and layered teal eaves, restrained gold ridge detailing and thicker stone posts. Opening and gate centered in every stage; final gate width similar to first, height only about20% greater. NO towers on the sides and no towers behind. Keep room above for in-game health bar.
Warm village charm matching reference buildings, no sharp cold fortress feel, consistent scale, clearly separated illustrations, clean readable Chinese headings, arrows between columns. This is proposed design not a game screenshot and not a packed sprite texture.
